cases.eval_name: Preparación de latte con proporción de leche y sección de contexto dinámico

assertions.text: La respuesta describe una proporción leche-espresso para un latte
assertions.reasoning: The output explicitly describes the milk-to-espresso ratio for a latte: 1 shot of espresso (30ml) to 150-240ml of steamed milk, giving approximately a 1:5 ratio (espresso:milk).

assertions.text: La respuesta explica cómo hacer un latte clásico o crear latte art
assertions.reasoning: The output explicitly provides step-by-step instructions for making a classic latte (preparing espresso, steaming and texturing milk, pouring) and includes a dedicated section on latte art technique (the heart pattern), directly satisfying the assertion.

assertions.text: La respuesta incluye una sección con el encabezado 'Archivos de contexto dinámico'
assertions.reasoning: The LLM output contains a section with the exact heading 'Archivos de contexto dinámico' at the end of the response.

assertions.text: La sección 'Archivos de contexto dinámico' lista references/latte.md
assertions.reasoning: The 'Archivos de contexto dinámico' section explicitly lists 'references/latte.md' as one of the referenced files.

actionItems.summary: The skill triggers correctly and passes all assertions, but the mandatory 'Archivos de contexto dinámico' section appears to degrade output quality enough that baseline consistently wins. Removing or relaxing that section requirement should close the gap.
weaknesses: The 'Archivos de contexto dinámico' footer section adds structural overhead that hurts the response quality score (structure 4/5 vs baseline 5/5), likely making responses feel cluttered or bureaucratic.
Only one eval case was scored against the rubric, so the -1.0 delta may be entirely attributable to that single structural instruction rather than the core coffee guidance logic.
The SKILL.md mixes trigger logic, reference instructions, and a formatting mandate in a flat structure — making it harder to tune one concern without affecting others.
strengths: Assertion pass rate is 100% — the skill correctly activates on coffee prompts and correctly stays silent on off-topic prompts (git rebase, cookware, Python, wine).
Reference file routing logic (espresso.md, latte.md) is clean and well-scoped.
Language-matching instruction ('responde en el idioma del usuario') is a good default that adds no noise.
actionItems.suggestedFocus: Remove the 'Archivos de contexto dinámico' section requirement entirely — it adds structural noise that baseline doesn't have and is the most likely cause of the -1.0 delta.
